newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end higher, just off late highs.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end higher, just off late highs.

text.p: Sept 25 - U.S. debt futures ended higher, just off peaks. Dec T-bonds ticked up to 109-10/32, a 61.8 pct retracement of the drop to 105-09/32 from 111-26/32 but stalled. Some still see more nearterm gains. Some Eurodollar brokers said huge buying from one dealer, which they thought was for funds, represented shift in sentiment to expect no Fed tigtening before yearend. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
